novel_features.name: SLA breach radar
novel_features.description: List tickets at risk of breaching SLA in the next N hours, optionally filtered by unassigned.

novel_features.name: Aging triage
novel_features.description: Open tickets where the last agent reply was more than N days ago.

novel_features.name: Conversational full-text search
novel_features.description: FTS5 search across ticket subject, description, threads, and comments.

novel_features.name: Workload fairness
novel_features.description: Per-agent open-ticket counts with mean/stddev/Gini across the team.

novel_features.name: Reopen-pattern detector
novel_features.description: Tickets that have been closed and reopened at least N times within a window.

novel_features.name: Reassignment helper
novel_features.description: Suggests the least-loaded active agent in a ticket's department for reassignment.

novel_features.name: Customer 360 view
novel_features.description: All tickets, accounts, and ticket stats for a contact in one query.

novel_features.name: Escalation audit
novel_features.description: Tickets reassigned to N or more distinct agents — surfaces ownership churn.
